name: SeongGyeong Park
role: Ph.D. Candidate in Education Policy and Planning · The University of Texas at Austin
heroTitle: Advancing Educational Equity. Transforming Systems. Empowering Communities.
heroDescription: My research examines systemic inequities in education, focusing on parenting and educational equity to inform more equitable policies and practices for marginalized families and communities across K–12 and higher education.
about: I am a Ph.D. candidate in Education Policy and Planning at The University of Texas at Austin. My scholarship examines parenting, educational leadership and policy, and the relationships and resources families and communities mobilize to challenge systemic inequities. I draw on community-engaged and asset-based perspectives to connect educational research with equitable policy and practice.

research.title: Parenting & Educational Equity
research.description: Parenting experiences, engagement, and educational opportunities across K–12 and higher education, particularly among families marginalized by language, race, class, and immigration status.

research.title: Educational Leadership & Policy
research.description: How educational leadership, institutional practices, and policies shape educational equity and opportunities for marginalized students, families, and communities.

research.title: Social Capital & Community-Driven Equity
research.description: How families and communities build and mobilize social networks, resources, and partnerships to navigate educational systems and challenge systemic inequities.

dissertationTitle: Understanding Newcomer Immigrant Parental Engagement within U.S. Schools
dissertationDescription: A qualitative case study examining newcomer parents’ experiences of engagement, the role of social capital, and the ways educational institutions support or constrain engagement. The study centers families’ perspectives and school–community relationships.
